text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security officials warn: government decisions on settlement expansion could ignite violence in territories.
- Despite international pressure, Syria still planning to buy nuclear power plant from Argentina.
- Israeli army jeep hit by petrol bomb near Druze village of Majdal Shams in Golan.
- Katyusha rockets land in Galilee; army kills two gunmen in south Lebanon security zone.
- Settlement policy is declaration of war -Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
- Jerusalem, with residents jittery over chance of suicide bombings, wants air force to stop sonic booms over city.
- Netanyahu to Clinton: We will not expand the settlements.
- Arafat in interview: Israeli settlement expansion is a time bomb.
- Israel's northern border tense after Katyusha landings on Friday.
- Security officials warn: territories on the verge of explosion.
- Treasury estimates November consumer price index will be 0.5 percent.
